name: io.github.lukBB/planpost
title: PlanPost
description: Let your AI agent draft, schedule and publish posts to 7 social networks and read the results.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Leave empty to sign in with OAuth (the client opens planpo.st in a browser). To use an API key instead, send: Bearer <key>; create one on the Agent page in PlanPost (starts with pk_live_).

environmentVariables.name: PLANPOST_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: PlanPost API key from the Agent page (starts with pk_live_).

environmentVariables.name: PLANPOST_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Only change it for a self-hosted PlanPost.
